items.exampleEn: Hair often clogs the bathroom drain.
items.exampleZh: 頭髮常常堵住浴室的排水管。

items.exampleEn: Grandpa tickled the baby's feet, and she laughed.
items.exampleZh: 爺爺搔寶寶的腳底，寶寶就笑了。

items.exampleEn: He compressed all his clothes into one small bag.
items.exampleZh: 他把所有衣服都壓進一個小袋子裡。

items.exampleEn: A huge wave engulfed the rocks on the beach.
items.exampleZh: 一道大浪吞沒了海灘上的岩石。

items.exampleEn: The smell of fresh bread permeated the whole house.
items.exampleZh: 剛出爐的麵包香瀰漫了整間屋子。

items.exampleEn: It took the climbers two days to traverse the snowy mountain.
items.exampleZh: 登山者花了兩天才橫越那座雪山。

items.exampleEn: The windows vibrated as the heavy truck passed.
items.exampleZh: 重型卡車經過時，窗戶都在震動。

items.exampleEn: The students were highly motivated to win the science fair.
items.exampleZh: 學生們非常有動力要贏得科展。

items.sentenceEn: The soft grass tickled my bare feet.
items.sentenceZh: 柔軟的草搔得我的光腳癢癢的。

items.audioEn: Please compress the photos before you email them; the files are too big.
items.audioZh: 寄照片前請先壓縮，檔案太大了。
items.questionZh: 說話者要對方先做什麼？
options: Email the photos as they are

items.sentenceEn: A good coach keeps the whole team motivated.
items.sentenceZh: 好教練能讓整支球隊保持幹勁。

items.sentenceEn: This machine compresses old cans into small blocks.
items.sentenceZh: 這台機器把舊罐子壓成小方塊。

items.stemEn: Water from the rain needs time to ____ the hard, dry soil.
items.stemZh: 雨水需要時間才能滲進又硬又乾的土壤。

items.stemEn: During the concert, the loud music made the whole floor ____.
items.stemZh: 演唱會上，音樂大聲到整個地板都在震動。

items.passageEn: On Saturday, our hiking club set out to traverse the long ridge above the lake. Thick fog soon engulfed the trail, and the cold permeated our thin jackets. Mud clogged our boots, so we walked slowly. When my phone vibrated, it was a message from the leader: everyone should wait at the old hut on the ridge. We rested there until the fog cleared, and then we finished the walk, tired but happy.
items.passageZh: 星期六，我們的健行社出發橫越湖上方那道長長的山脊。濃霧很快籠罩了步道，寒氣也滲進我們單薄的外套。泥巴塞滿了靴子，所以我們走得很慢。我的手機震動時，是領隊傳來的訊息：大家到山脊上的舊小屋等。我們在那裡休息到霧散，然後走完全程，雖然累但很開心。

questions.questionZh: 健行途中，大家的靴子怎麼了？
收到訊息後，大家去了哪裡？

items.promptZh: 我哥哥最近很有動力，每天早上都去跑步。
referenceEn: My brother has been very motivated lately and runs every morning.
My brother is really motivated these days, so he goes running every morning.
rubricZh: 要用 motivated（例如 be motivated、feel motivated）
「最近」可寫，例如 lately、these days、recently 等
「每天早上去跑步」可寫，例如 runs every morning、goes running every morning 等

items.promptZh: 風一吹，我的頭髮就一直搔著我的臉。
referenceEn: When the wind blows, my hair keeps tickling my face.
My hair keeps tickling my face when the wind blows.
rubricZh: tickle 當動詞「輕輕搔、使發癢」（例如 keeps tickling my face、tickles my face 等）
「一直」可寫，例如 keeps …ing、always 等；時態配合句意（例如 blows、blew 等）
